description: This file defines functions, constants, and types related to managing bundled plugin metadata in a plugin system, including loading, resolving paths, and caching plugin data.

classes.name: BundledPluginMetadata
classes.description: Type representing metadata for a bundled plugin, including paths, package info, and manifest data.

classes.name: ChannelConfigSurface
classes.description: Type representing the schema, UI hints, and runtime info for a plugin channel configuration.

methods.name: clearBundledPluginMetadataCache
methods.description: Clears the cache of bundled plugin metadata.

methods.name: listBundledPluginMetadata
methods.description: Returns a list of all bundled plugin metadata, optionally filtered by root directory and config inclusion.

methods.name: findBundledPluginMetadataById
methods.description: Finds a specific bundled plugin metadata entry by plugin ID.

methods.name: resolveBundledPluginWorkspaceSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the filesystem path to the workspace source of a bundled plugin by ID.

methods.name: resolveBundledPluginGeneratedPath
methods.description: Resolves the filesystem path to a generated plugin artifact based on its source and built paths.

methods.name: resolveBundledPluginPublicSurfacePath
methods.description: Resolves the filesystem path to a public surface artifact of a plugin, considering environment and directory options.
